messages:
Maya Patel: Proposing Aurelia Labs private rollout tonight 2026-03-28 22:00 UTC. Starting preflight checks now. Main blockers: KMS rotation and ensuring model pin for v3.2.0 is honored across slices.
DeployBot: deploy request received tenant=aurelia-labs env=private image=redwood-inference:v3.2.0 rollout=staggered-slices
Saj Malik: Heads up: KMS rotation currently scheduled for 23:40 UTC. That overlaps if we start at 22:00. Recommend shifting to 00:45 UTC or delaying KMS.
Elaine Cho: Let me check with Security. If rotation is a rewrap without access revocation, we might be safe with a short overlap. Will confirm.
OpsBot: canary slice queued. slice=canary-a size=2gpus expected_ramp=8m watch=p50,p95,4xx,kvcache_eviction
Ryan O'Neill: Release notes draft: https://confluence.redwood/aurelia/v3.2.0 - highlights: new quantized kernel, KV cache stability fixes, telemetry v2.2. Backward fallback to v3.1.5 available.
Maya Patel: Need explicit rollback rules in thread: propose rollback if p50 latency > 150ms increase over baseline for 3 consecutive minutes OR sustained 4xx > 0.4% for 5m. Also early-warning: KVCACHE eviction > 15% for 10m.
Saj Malik: +1 on rollback thresholds. Also request ops to monitor GC and disk i/o on nodes during canary.
Elaine Cho: Confirmed with Security: rotation is key rewrap only, no key revocation. We can rotate at 23:50 UTC and leave a 55m buffer before a 00:45 start. Approving from sec side. audit log will record rotation.
Product-SR: We ran A/B prompt set (A1) against v3.2.0 vs v3.1.5. Behavioral diffs within tolerance. Approving from product.
Maya Patel: OK shifting start to 00:45 UTC. Ops, Saj, Elaine, Product-SR, Ryan please ack and I'll queue if all green.
Saj Malik: Ack. KMS rotate scheduled 23:50 UTC. I approve the window and rollback criteria.
Elaine Cho: Approved. audit retention=90d noted.
Ryan O'Neill: Approved. small expected token-cost uptick (approx +2%).
Product-SR: Approved.
Maya Patel: Queuing rollout now. DeployBot will update slices here.
DeployBot: rollout queued -> slice 1/4 scheduled ETA 00:55 UTC
DeployBot: slice 1/4 started at 2026-03-29T00:55:00Z
Maya Patel: running smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/aurelia/predict -d '{"prompt":"test"}'` -> 200, latency 85ms
DeployBot: slice 1/4 success, metrics nominal
DeployBot: slice 2/4 started
DeployBot: slice 2/4 warning: p50 +95ms vs baseline for 3m, alerting ops
OpsBot: investigating slice-2 latency spike 1 checking node metrics, cache priming, and threadpool saturation
Saj Malik: seeing increased GC cycles on host-7. Draining and restarting runtime on that node.
DeployBot: slice-2 recovered, p50 back near baseline. resuming rollout.
DeployBot: slice 3/4 success
DeployBot: slice 4/4 success. rollout complete: 4/4 slices.
DeployBot: final status: tenant=aurelia-labs version_pinned=v3.2.0 rollback_mode=manual-only until 04:30 UTC as per canary policy
Maya Patel: Pausing auto-rollbacks per policy; manual rollback will require SRE + Product signoff until 04:30 UTC. Postmortem entry and final release notes will be put on confluence. Thanks everyone. :tada:
